text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, mesalamine 0.375 g capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 49 capsules (5.5 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules (27.4 days). Corvale General holds 163 capsules (17 days). The top-ranked option is to transfer 24 capsules from Lakeside to East, leaving Lakeside with two weeks of supply and raising East to 8 days. An alternative transfers 28 capsules from General to East, leaving General with two weeks and raising East to 9 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows discontinued postings for Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. on 2026-08-25 and Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. on 2026-09-16, but these are for different NDCs. The product label for NDC 70771162507 names Zydus Lifesciences Limited as labeler and a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2023-03-24.

Our position: Internal supply can cover the East shortfall through inter-site transfers without purchasing from unvetted sources. Both transfer options preserve a two-week buffer at the sending site.

Recommended actions:
1. Approve transfer of 24 capsules from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. If Lakeside transfer is not feasible, approve transfer of 28 capsules from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Monitor FDA shortage list daily for any new postings affecting our NDCs — requires buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, or Ascend Laboratories, LLC at this time because their labels name no plant we could verify and they are not on FDA's shortage list.
